Description: VilotNI 2 lexical database. Words expose possible POS_Type identities, morphology, variants, and bounded lexical associations; active POS is resolved per occurrence by RSL from learned context. Schema 4 adds derived lexical-graph bridges so RSL can explore wider word neighborhoods without consulting TrainingInfo.json for answers.
Design_Rules: Word_Types are surface or grammatical variants of a parent lexical entry.
Root_Family is used by Processor.js to stop derivational repetition inside a clause.
Associations are retrieval hints, not automatically trusted factual claims.
Original_Token_ID preserves the VilotNI 1.5 token ID when available.

Role: Lexical inventory and possible grammatical identities. Words.json does not prescribe factual answers or fixed sentence trajectories.

Connection_To_TrainingInfo.TrainingInfo: retained beside the model as a reference/benchmark dataset but not loaded by the VilotNI 2 response path in this build
Connection_To_TrainingInfo.Words: supplies sayable tokens, morphology, variants, and possible POS_Type identities
Connection_To_TrainingInfo.Rule: POS_Type is a set of lexical possibilities; RSL and Correlation learn which role is active from context. No TrainingInfo entry may directly answer a prompt.

Lexical_Graph_Expansion.Purpose: Broaden response vocabulary from existing lexical relationships; these edges are retrieval hints, not factual proof.
Lexical_Graph_Expansion.Policy: Only curated entry subjects/keywords/aliases/Related_To tokens are used as lexical context. Definition, mechanism and capability sentences are not imported.
